raw_text: Satellite images reveal Pakistan's Special Service Group conducting intensified training near the Line of Control in the Kotli sector of Pakistan-administered Kashmir. Defence sources told the Times of India that the training facility, located 12 km from the LoC, has seen unusual activity including temporary encampments and vehicle movements suggesting a battalion-level exercise. Indian Army's Northern Command has enhanced surveillance along the sector. Intelligence agencies are assessing whether the activity is linked to any operational planning.
clean_text: Pakistan SSG conducting intensified training 12km from LoC in Kotli sector. Northern Command enhanced surveillance. Intelligence assessing if linked to operational planning.
